title: Bobby Ray Inman acknowledges the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office

plain: A secret agency called the National Underwater (or Undersea) Reconnaissance Office, "NURO" for short, really exists, according to a man named Bobby Ray Inman, who is said to have mentioned it and "basically acknowledged it was a real thing." Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral and former head oceanographer of the Navy, relays this to Michels and also names a man called Sam Gerbus in telling it. Gallaudet adds that in all his years with access to classified undersea programmes he had "never even heard of that organization," which, if the agency exists, would mean it is hidden even from senior Navy insiders.
